type: Power Stack dashboard factor sweep — transcript hypotheses independently verified
sourcePolicy: StockedUp, FXEvolution and TradeBrigade are discovery inputs only. Dashboard promotion requires current market, official, company or high-quality reporting evidence. New diagnostic channels do not change stock macro-adjusted conviction until an explicit stock sensitivity is researched and added.
headlineRead: The dashboard should stop treating the current regime as a single risk-on/risk-off signal. The useful split is physical scarcity and funded capex strength versus duration, breadth and financing fragility, with earnings revisions as the main counterweight.

factorMap.videoIdea: Refining, not just crude supply, is the hidden inflation bottleneck.
factorMap.verifiedRead: EIA shows US operable refining capacity around 18.027m b/d and 98.0% utilization for the week ending Aug 28. Elevated gasoline/product crack spreads confirm little spare refining slack. The creator claim of the lowest capacity ever is not used.
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Keep Refined Products at maximum stress, but add utilization/spare-capacity context so the dashboard can distinguish crude scarcity from refinery/product scarcity.
factorMap.confirmation: Utilization remains >95% while cracks stay elevated and distillate inventories remain abnormally tight.
factorMap.invalidation: Utilization normalizes with rebuilt product inventories and sustained crack compression.

factorMap.videoIdea: Treasury support is failing to stop the rise in long yields.
factorMap.verifiedRead: Treasury announced up to $6bn of 10-20Y buybacks for Sep 10; after the announcement the 10Y reached about 4.8528%. Treat the reaction as a clearing-rate/news-failure signal rather than proof that buybacks cannot work.
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Financial Conditions stays at maximum restrictive. Add a duration-clearing monitor to separate Fed/front-end repricing from long-end fiscal/term-premium stress.
factorMap.confirmation: Long yields remain high or rise despite buybacks and softer growth data.
factorMap.invalidation: Long yields and real yields compress durably while auction quality improves.

factorMap.videoIdea: Headline indices hide a deteriorating market underneath, especially equal-weight and small caps.
factorMap.verifiedRead: Sep 9 had 383 S&P 500 decliners; NYSE decliners outnumbered advancers by nearly 3:1 and Nasdaq by more than 2.5:1. Russell 2000 fell about 1.1%-1.3% and is below its 50-day average while large caps remain closer to highs.
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Add a first-class Equity Breadth diagnostic. It raises fragility/rate sensitivity but is not allowed to create a crash regime by itself.
factorMap.confirmation: Breadth keeps deteriorating while yields rise and headline indices remain concentrated.
factorMap.invalidation: RSP/IWM regain trend and breadth improves alongside the cap-weighted indices.

factorMap.videoIdea: Forward earnings are still improving even as the tape weakens.
factorMap.verifiedRead: FactSet reports Q3 bottom-up S&P 500 EPS estimates rose 1.2% from June 30 to Aug 31, versus normal declines of roughly 1.7%-2.1% over the first two months of a quarter.
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Add Earnings Support as an explicit green counter-signal so deteriorating breadth does not mechanically become a broad bearish call.
factorMap.confirmation: Forward estimates and revision breadth remain positive and beats are rewarded.
factorMap.invalidation: Estimate revisions roll over broadly and good earnings are consistently sold.

factorMap.videoIdea: AI is increasingly competing with sovereigns and other borrowers for capital.
factorMap.verifiedRead: Hyperscalers have issued more than $200bn of debt in 2026. Amazon raised £4.25bn on Sep 9; ECB analysis shows hyperscaler euro spreads rising as issuance expectations increase and warns of potential crowding-out channels.
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Add AI Funding Quality as a separate diagnostic from Industrial/AI/Power Capex. Demand can remain +2 while funding quality deteriorates; that divergence is now central to stock selection.
factorMap.confirmation: Spreads/concessions rise, issuance accelerates and FCF conversion lags capex.
factorMap.invalidation: Funding costs fall while FCF and signed contracted demand improve.

factorMap.videoIdea: The energy shock is spreading through LNG, European gas and electricity rather than crude alone.
factorMap.verifiedRead: Reuters reports European gas above €75/MWh with storage around 66%, Germany around 54% and the Netherlands around 48%; Middle Eastern LNG exports are down about 85% amid Hormuz disruption, forcing stronger competition for Atlantic LNG.
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Add Global LNG Availability separately from US Gas. Henry Hub can remain moderate while Europe/Asia gas is acutely tight; combining them hides the inflation transmission.
factorMap.confirmation: TTF/JKM stay high, storage refill lags and Atlantic cargo competition persists.
factorMap.invalidation: Middle East LNG flows normalize and storage rebuilds with collapsing regional spreads.

factorMap.videoIdea: Copper is confirming AI/grid demand but may not be confirming broad economic health.
factorMap.verifiedRead: Copper is at record levels amid mine-supply weakness, tariff uncertainty and grid/AI demand. Refined production can still be adequate and China private-credit transmission remains soft, so copper must be decomposed into scarcity versus broad-growth components.
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Keep Copper structurally positive but label the signal 'scarcity/grid' rather than generic global-growth confirmation.
factorMap.confirmation: Physical premiums/inventory draws and mine constraints persist alongside grid orders.
factorMap.invalidation: Inventories rebuild and physical premiums/orders weaken.

factorMap.videoIdea: Gold is being supported by reserve diversification even with high yields.
factorMap.verifiedRead: World Gold Council reports August global gold ETF inflows of $18bn and 121t, taking holdings to a record 4,189t. July central-bank purchases included China +20t and Poland +8t.
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Gold remains a strategic positive channel, but real yields stay the tactical timing gate.
factorMap.confirmation: ETF/official demand remains strong despite high real yields.
factorMap.invalidation: ETF flows reverse while real yields/USD break higher and bullion loses trend support.

factorMap.videoIdea: Regional banks, junk bonds and consumer-credit names may be early warning signals.
factorMap.verifiedRead: The existing dashboard already separates broad credit from weak-end credit; the useful expansion is to monitor whether higher yields spread from CCC/small caps into banks, consumer credit and otherwise healthy IG credit.
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Do not create a new crisis channel yet. Strengthen the existing weak-end-credit monitor and promote only if stress broadens into quality credit/banks.
factorMap.confirmation: Spreads widen across quality tiers and bank/consumer-credit stress broadens.
factorMap.invalidation: Weak-end stress stays isolated while broad IG/banks stabilize.

factorMap.videoIdea: CPI/PPI, options walls and volatility can dominate the immediate market reaction.
factorMap.verifiedRead: PPI Sep 10 and CPI Sep 11 are the immediate catalysts. Creator-specific SPX/QQQ option levels are useful tactical hypotheses but should remain in Positioning, not the macro regime layer, unless independently sourced.
lookUpContinuously: dealer gamma/put-call levels from licensed source
factorMap.dashboardEffect: Keep event/option mechanics out of Macro Pulse scoring. Surface them in Positioning and use post-data price reaction as confirmation/invalidation of the macro regime.
factorMap.confirmation: Hot data pushes yields higher and weak breadth/credit lower.
factorMap.invalidation: Hot data is absorbed with falling yields and improving breadth — a bullish news-failure signal.

dashboardChanges.scoringGuardrail: The four new diagnostics are display/research channels only. They remain absent from stock sensitivity fingerprints, so they contribute zero to macro-adjusted conviction until researched stock-level sensitivities are explicitly added.
